study type: Mendelian Randomization utilizing data from cohort studies
exposure: Maternal smoking in pregnancy (quitting vs. continuing)
Number of cigarettes smoked per day in the first trimester
Smoking at the end of pregnancy
outcome: Offspring birth weight relative to placental weight
cohort: Pre-pregnancy smoking mothers (N=690-804 from ALSPAC and N=4267-4606 from MoBa cohorts).
finding: Continued maternal smoking during pregnancy causes higher placental weights and a lower offspring birth weight relative to placental weight.
birth_weight: Mentioned as an outcome: offspring birth weight.
